actions: Assess competence against the role: relevant insurance, financial reporting, actuarial or risk experience, prior board or executive service, and any professional qualification required by the position.
Assess propriety from the screening and affidavit results, weighing the seriousness, recency and relevance of anything adverse rather than applying an automatic bar.
Assess conflicts from the questionnaire: outside directorships, competitor relationships, family employment, related-party dealings, and time commitment against the over-boarding policy.
Write a one-page fitness memo per individual with the evidence, the conclusion and any conditions attached, and sign it before the appointment resolution is tabled.
checklist.done: each appointment has a signed fitness memo covering competence, propriety and conflicts with the evidence cited.

checklist.step: Take the appointment to the board with the fitness evidence
actions: Table the fitness memo, the screening summary and the independence assessment at the Nominating and Governance Committee, then at the board.
Minute the appointment resolution with the effective date, the committee memberships and the confirmation that the fitness assessment was received.
Where an adverse finding exists, minute the board's specific consideration of it and the reason the appointment proceeds.
Update the board portal roster, the Workday record and the state officer list on the effective date.
checklist.done: the appointment is minuted with the fitness assessment received, any adverse finding specifically considered, and all rosters updated on the effective date.

checklist.step: Notify the regulators and file the required disclosures
actions: File the Form 8-K Item 5.02 disclosure within 4 business days of the appointment or departure, including the Item 401(f) proceedings and any related-party transaction the rule requires.
Notify each domiciliary and licensing state of the change in director or officer within its deadline, commonly 30 days, attaching the biographical affidavit where required.
For Section 16 officers arrange the Form 3 filing within 10 days of becoming an insider and confirm EDGAR filing codes are issued in time.
Record every notification, its deadline and its submission date in the regulatory filing log.
checklist.done: the 8-K Item 5.02, state officer notifications and any Form 3 are filed within their deadlines and logged.

checklist.step: Apply the SOX 402 prohibition to every credit arrangement
actions: Publish the prohibition: the company and its subsidiaries may not directly or indirectly extend, maintain, arrange for or renew any personal loan to a director or executive officer.

Map the arrangements that can become a loan in substance: salary advances, relocation and tax equalisation advances, split-dollar life insurance, stock option exercise loans, deferred compensation loans, and unreimbursed personal expenses on a company card left outstanding.

Configure the general ledger and the expense system to block any advance, employee receivable or credit posting against an individual tagged as a director or executive officer, and route any attempt to Treasury and General Counsel.

Record the only permitted exception - a loan made in the ordinary course of a consumer credit business the company itself operates, on market terms generally available to the public, of a type generally made available to the public - and require General Counsel approval to rely on it.
checklist.done: system blocks prevent any advance or receivable posting against a covered individual and the consumer-credit exception can only be used with a recorded legal approval.

checklist.step: Sweep the ledger for balances that behave like loans
actions: Run a quarterly query over employee receivable, travel advance, prepaid and other asset accounts for any balance where the counterparty is a director or executive officer.
Age every balance found and treat anything outstanding beyond the normal reimbursement cycle as a potential extension of credit needing legal analysis.
Review company card statements for personal charges by covered individuals and confirm they were settled by the individual directly rather than carried by the company.
Report the sweep result, including nil results, to General Counsel and the Audit Committee each quarter.
checklist.done: a quarterly ledger sweep of receivable and advance accounts for covered individuals is reported to General Counsel and the Audit Committee, nil results included.

checklist.step: Refresh the assessment annually with the questionnaire
actions: Issue the annual questionnaire to every director and executive officer and require confirmation or update of every prior disclosure, not merely a signature.
Re-run sanctions and adverse media screening annually and criminal record checks on the cycle the policy sets.
Compare each response to the prior year and investigate every change in outside directorships, related-party dealings or legal proceedings.
Update the fitness memo for anyone whose circumstances changed and take a material change to the Nominating and Governance Committee.
checklist.done: every covered individual completes an annual refresh with re-screening, and every changed answer is investigated and reflected in an updated memo.

checklist.step: Handle an adverse event affecting a serving officer or director
actions: Require immediate self-reporting of any arrest, charge, regulatory action, licence issue or personal insolvency, and state the reporting deadline as 2 business days from the event.
On notification, assess the effect on the person's fitness for the role and on any insurer licence or Section 16 status, and decide whether suspension from duties is required pending the outcome.
Assess the disclosure obligations: Item 401(f) in the next proxy or 10-K, Form 8-K Item 5.02 if the person departs, and state notification if they are an insurer officer.
Report to the Nominating and Governance Committee chair and the Audit Committee chair within 2 business days and record the decision and its basis.
checklist.done: each adverse event is reported within 2 business days, assessed for fitness, disclosure and licensing effect, and escalated to both committee chairs.

checklist.step: Test the departure and cooling-off obligations on exit
actions: On departure, remove the covered tags in Workday, revoke system entitlements and remove signing authority, board portal access and bank mandates the same day.
Settle any outstanding advance, card balance or receivable before the final payment so no balance becomes a prohibited loan after employment ends.
Confirm any separation payment complies with the clawback policy and the compensation recovery requirements of SEC Rule 10D-1 where a restatement is in progress.
Notify the states of the officer change within their deadlines and file the Form 8-K Item 5.02 within 4 business days.
checklist.done: on departure all access and authority are removed the same day, balances are settled, clawback is assessed and regulators are notified in their windows.

checklist.step: Report the fitness position to the committee
actions: Prepare an annual report to the Nominating and Governance Committee showing the covered population, appointments and departures in the year, screening completion rates and any adverse findings.
Include the quarterly SOX 402 sweep results and confirm whether any credit arrangement was identified.
List every biographical affidavit whose third-party verification will pass 3 years before the next report, so refreshes are commissioned in time.
Minute the committee's consideration and record any direction as a tracked action.
checklist.done: the committee receives an annual fitness report with screening completion, sweep results and affidavit ageing, minuted with tracked actions.

checklist.step: Control access to the screening data
actions: Restrict access to screening reports, affidavits and criminal record results to named individuals in Legal, HR and the Corporate Secretariat, and review the access list quarterly.
Confirm the lawful basis and the candidate consent for each screening type and apply the retention rule of 7 years after the individual leaves office.
Confirm the vendor contracts carry the required data protection terms and that reports are transferred through the secure channel rather than by email.
Log any access to a screening record so an unauthorised read can be detected.
checklist.done: screening data access is restricted to a reviewed named list, consent and retention are documented and every access is logged.

checklist.step: Archive the fitness file per individual
actions: File per individual the fitness memo, screening summary, biographical affidavit and verification report, questionnaires, board resolution, regulatory notifications and any adverse event record.
Apply the retention label of 7 years after the individual leaves office and confirm the restricted access permissions carry over.
Confirm the record is searchable by individual, role, appointment date and affidavit verification date.
Give Internal Audit read access in place so testing does not require copies of personal data to be made.
checklist.done: each covered individual has a complete archived fitness file under restricted access, retained 7 years after they leave office.

testing.step: Build the population of covered individuals and appointments
actions: Extract from Workday every individual tagged executive officer, Section 16 officer, financial reporting oversight role, insurer officer or insurer director at any point in the year, with start and end dates.
Extract every appointment, promotion and departure affecting those tags with its effective date.
Reconcile the list to the board minutes, the proxy officer list and the officer lists filed with each domiciliary state, and resolve every difference.
Sign the population as complete with the extract date and record count.
testing.done: the covered population reconciles to board minutes, the proxy and state officer filings, signed as complete.

testing.step: Reconcile appointments to a completed pre-appointment assessment
actions: Match each appointment to a signed fitness memo and a completed screening record and compare their dates to the appointment effective date.
Treat any appointment whose screening or memo is dated after the effective date as an automatic exception with the day count recorded.
List every appointment with no fitness memo at all as a control failure rather than a documentation gap.
Confirm the board minute for each appointment records receipt of the fitness assessment.
testing.done: every appointment matches a pre-dated fitness memo and screening record or is logged as an exception with a day count.

testing.step: Draw a documented sample of individuals and arrangements
actions: Take 100 percent of appointments and departures in the year, all Section 16 officers and all insurer directors and officers.
Take 15 further covered individuals by seeded random selection from those serving throughout the year.
Add every individual with an adverse screening finding, a disclosed legal proceeding or any ledger balance identified in the quarterly sweeps.
Record the seed, population size and selection date so the sample can be redrawn identically.
testing.done: a reproducible sample covers all appointments, departures, Section 16 and insurer officers and every adverse or ledger-flagged individual.

testing.step: Re-perform the screening and affidavit verification checks
actions: For each sampled individual open the screening record in place and confirm every required check was performed, returned and read, not merely ordered.
Independently re-run the public regulatory lookups - FINRA BrokerCheck, SEC Action Lookup and the state insurance licence and disciplinary registers - and compare the results to the file.

For insurer officers confirm the biographical affidavit is complete with no employment gap and that the third-party verification report is dated within 3 years of the state filing date, recording both dates.
Confirm the 18 U.S.C. 1033 prohibited-person check was performed and, where a conviction exists, that written consent from the commissioner is on file.
testing.done: screening completeness is verified, public registers are independently re-run, and affidavit verification age is recomputed against the filing date.

testing.step: Re-perform the Item 401(f) disclosure assessment
actions: For each sampled individual search public court, bankruptcy, SEC and CFTC records for the last ten years and compare the results to the questionnaire answers.
Where a proceeding exists, reach your own conclusion on whether it is material to an evaluation of integrity before reading the company assessment.
Trace every proceeding judged disclosable into the filed proxy or 10-K text and confirm the description is accurate and complete.
Log any proceeding found in public records but absent from both the questionnaire and the filing as a disclosure exception.
testing.done: public record searches are re-performed for every sampled individual and each disclosable proceeding traces to accurate filed text.

testing.step: Test the SOX 402 loan prohibition against the ledger and payroll
actions: Query employee receivable, advance, prepaid, other asset and suspense accounts for any transaction or balance naming a covered individual at any point in the year, not only at quarter ends.
Query payroll for advances, loans against deferred compensation and any repayment deduction, and query the company card system for personal charges carried beyond the settlement cycle.
For each item found, compute the days outstanding and assess whether the company extended, maintained, arranged or renewed credit within the meaning of Section 13(k).
Treat any item relying on the consumer-credit exception as a fail unless a recorded General Counsel approval and evidence of market terms generally available to the public exist.
testing.done: ledger, payroll and card data are swept for every covered individual with days outstanding computed and every exception-reliance tested.

testing.step: Recompute the regulatory notification deadlines
actions: For each appointment and departure recompute the 4-business-day Form 8-K Item 5.02 window from the event date and compare it to the EDGAR acceptance timestamp.
Recompute each state officer notification deadline from the applicable statute, commonly 30 days, and compare it to the submission date recorded in the filing log.
For Section 16 officers recompute the Form 3 10-day window and any Form 4 2-business-day window and compare to the filing dates.
Record the days early or late for every notification and treat any late filing as an exception regardless of whether the regulator objected.
testing.done: every 8-K, state notification and Section 16 deadline is independently recomputed with days early or late recorded.

testing.step: Test the annual refresh, departures and data controls
actions: Confirm every covered individual completed the annual questionnaire refresh before the proxy filing and that re-screening was performed on the policy cycle.
For each departure confirm system entitlements, board portal access, signing authority and bank mandates were removed on the departure date, taking the removal timestamps from the access records.
Confirm every outstanding advance or card balance was settled before the final payment and that no balance persisted after employment ended.
Sample 5 screening records and confirm access was restricted to the named list and that each access was logged.
testing.done: refresh completion, same-day access removal timestamps, settled balances and restricted screening access are all evidenced.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise an issue per exception naming the individual, the requirement missed, the day count where a deadline applies and whether a filing or an unwind is required.

Assign a root cause (appointment effective before screening returned, affidavit verification aged out, ledger block bypassed, notification calendar entry missing, refresh not chased) and a named owner.
For any credit extension, require General Counsel to record the legal analysis, the unwind mechanics and whether disclosure or self-report is needed, with a date.
Carry every open exception into the next quarterly sweep and the next annual test as a mandatory item.
testing.done: each exception has an issue, a root cause, an owner, a remediation date, and for credit items a recorded legal analysis and unwind plan.

testing.step: Conclude, obtain independent sign-off and report
actions: Compute the exception rate over appointments, notifications and ledger items and compare it to the zero-tolerance threshold for unscreened appointments and any credit extension.

Write the conclusion - fitness and propriety controls are effective, effective with exceptions, or ineffective - citing the screening re-performance, public record searches, ledger sweep and deadline recomputation.
Have a reviewer who reports to none of the sampled officers and took part in no sampled appointment decision sign the workpaper with name and date.

Report the conclusion and any credit extension or unscreened appointment to the Nominating and Governance Committee and the Audit Committee at the next meeting and file the workpaper in the evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper states the exception rate, a conclusion and the committee reporting date, filed in the evidence repository.

Accountable obligation owner.value: Chief Actuary owns the reserve estimation policy and its assumption governance and takes it to the board for annual approval; the Controller owns the SOX key controls over the reserve balance and the Corporate Secretary records the board approval

Citation verified against current regula.value: Yes - SOX 404 (15 U.S.C. 7262) with SEC Interpretive Guidance Release 33-8810 on controls over significant estimates, read alongside ASC 944 for the liability for unpaid claims disclosure, the NAIC Actuarial Opinion and Memorandum requirements for the Appointed Actuary, and Actuarial Standards of Practice 36 and 43 governing reserve estimation

In-scope processes.value: Annual board approval of the reserving, model risk, capital and investment policies, and the ICFR key controls over the actuarial estimation of loss and loss adjustment expense reserves and policyholder liabilities: data completeness from the claims and policy systems, assumption setting and governance, model validation and change control, the reserve committee review, the actuarial-to-ledger booking and the roll-forward disclosure

In-scope systems.value: The reserving platform holds the triangles, methods and selected ultimates; the claims and policy administration platforms are the data sources tested for completeness and accuracy, the model governance repository holds validations and the general ledger holds the booked reserve

Compliance procedure documented.value: Reserve Estimation Control Procedure and the Reserving Policy - data extract reconciliation standard, segmentation, method selection and assumption change rules, model validation and change control, the reserve committee terms of reference, the booking and roll-forward standard and the annual board approval cycle

Compliance procedure approved.value: Reserving policy approved annually by the board on the recommendation of the Audit Committee and the Risk Committee, with the Chief Actuary and the Appointed Actuary confirming it remains consistent with ASOP 36 and 43 and with the statutory actuarial opinion basis

Filing/reporting deadlines tracked.value: Board approval of the reserving and model risk policies each year before the year-end reserve review, typically at the Q4 board meeting; reserve committee meets quarterly ahead of each close; the Statement of Actuarial Opinion is due with the annual statement by 1 March; the Actuarial Report supporting the opinion is due to the board and the domiciliary state, commonly by 1 May; the ASC 944 development table is filed with the 10-K

Deadline reminders configured.value: Board portal reminders for the annual policy review at T-45 and T-14 days to the Q4 board meeting, quarterly reserve committee scheduling ahead of each close cut, and alerts to the Chief Actuary at 60 and 30 days before the 1 March opinion and the 1 May actuarial report dates

Evidence retained per the retention requ.value: Board approval resolutions and the approved policy versions retained permanently; reserve data reconciliations, assumption change memos, model validations, reserve committee packs and minutes, the booking entry support and the actuarial report retained 7 years from the end of the fiscal year under the SOX 802 audit-records rule

Violations/exceptions logged with dispos.value: A reserve data extract that does not reconcile to the claims system, an assumption changed without committee approval, a model version used without a current validation, a booked reserve outside the actuarial range without documented rationale, or a policy not board-approved in the year is logged with severity, owner and remediation date

Remediation sign-off captured.value: CFO signs off remediation of any reserve control failure and confirms the effect on the booked balance; the Audit Committee approves closure of any deficiency touching the reserve estimate before the year-end ICFR conclusion

Test population (in-scope transactions,.value: All key controls over reserve estimation in the year-end RCM, all reserve segments and their data extracts, every assumption and method change made in the year, every model version used, the four quarterly reserve committee packs and minutes, the booking journals, and the governance policies requiring board approval

Pass/fail thresholds.value: Zero tolerance - a reserve data extract that does not reconcile to the claims and policy systems within the stated tolerance fails, any assumption or method change without documented committee approval fails, any model version in production without a current validation fails, any booked reserve outside the actuarial indicated range without a documented and approved rationale fails, and any in-scope policy not board-approved in the year fails

Compliance test frequency matched to the.value: Board policy approval is annual and is tested once a year against the minutes; the reserve estimation controls operate quarterly, so they are tested every quarter with a full re-performance at the year-end reserve review before the ICFR conclusion

Independent reviewer (segregated from th.value: Model Risk validates the reserving models and reviews assumption changes independently of the Reserving Actuary who sets them, and reports to the Chief Risk Officer; Internal Audit tests the surrounding controls

Evidence location for test results.value: AuditBoard reserve cycle testing folder with the data reconciliation, assumption change and model validation workpapers, cross-linked to the model governance repository and the reserve committee minutes in the board portal

Regulator-ready documentation.value: Approved reserving and model risk policies with the board resolutions, reserve committee packs and minutes, data reconciliations, assumption change memos, model validation reports and the booking support, producible to the SEC staff, the PCAOB inspectors or the domiciliary state examiner within 5 business days

Regulator response path.value: State examination questions on reserve adequacy route to the Chief Actuary and the Appointed Actuary with the Statutory Reporting Manager; SEC comments on the ASC 944 development disclosure route to the Controller and Regulatory Counsel; the CFO clears both and the Audit Committee chair is briefed before response

checklist.step: Set the annual governance policy approval calendar
actions: List every policy requiring board or committee approval in the year - reserving, model risk management, investment, capital and liquidity, reinsurance, underwriting authority, ORSA, code of conduct, delegation of authority - with its owner, approving body and last approval date.
Schedule each policy to a specific board or committee meeting and load the dates into the board portal with T-45 and T-14 reminders to the owner.
Confirm the reserving and model risk policies are scheduled before the year-end reserve review so the year-end estimate runs under an approved policy.
Report any policy more than 12 months past its last approval to the Nominating and Governance Committee as an overdue item.
checklist.done: every in-scope policy has a scheduled approval meeting, an owner and reminders, with overdue policies reported to the committee.

checklist.step: Refresh the reserving policy and take it to the board
actions: Update the reserving policy to state the reserve segmentation, the methods permitted for each segment, the assumption governance route, the range and best estimate convention, the reserve committee membership and quorum, and the escalation path for a booking outside the indicated range.
Confirm with the Appointed Actuary that the policy remains consistent with ASOP 36 and 43 and with the basis of the statutory actuarial opinion.
Circulate the redline and a summary of changes to the Audit Committee and the Risk Committee at least 5 business days before the meeting.
Obtain the board resolution approving the policy and record the version number and effective date in the resolution.
checklist.done: a version-numbered reserving policy consistent with ASOP 36 and 43 is board-approved by resolution with an effective date recorded.

checklist.step: Reconcile the reserving data extract to the source systems
actions: Extract paid losses, case reserves, claim counts, recoveries and earned premium by accident period and segment as at the valuation date, recording the extract query, parameters and run timestamp.
Reconcile paid and case amounts in the extract to the claims platform control totals and to the general ledger balance, and record the three figures and the differences.
Investigate and document every difference above the stated tolerance before the triangles are built, and never adjust the extract without recording the reason and the approver.
Have a second analyst re-run the reconciliation independently and sign it, and attach both to the reserve working file.
checklist.done: the extract reconciles to claims platform control totals and the ledger within tolerance, with every difference explained and a second signed reconciliation attached.

checklist.step: Test the completeness and accuracy of the exposure and premium data
actions: Reconcile earned premium and in-force exposure by segment from the policy administration platform to the general ledger and to the statutory annual statement exhibits.
Test for missing accident periods, negative paid amounts, claims with no accident date, and claims coded to a segment inconsistent with the policy coverage, and quantify each anomaly.
Trace 25 individual claims from the claims file into the triangle cell they land in and 25 triangle cells back to the underlying claim records.
Publish the data quality report with the anomaly counts and the resolution of each, and give it to the Reserving Actuary before methods are selected.
checklist.done: premium and exposure reconcile to the ledger and statutory exhibits, anomalies are quantified and resolved, and two-way tracing of 25 claims each way is documented.

checklist.step: Select methods and set assumptions under documented governance
actions: For each segment select the methods - paid and incurred development, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, expected loss ratio, frequency-severity - and record why the method fits the segment maturity and data volume.

Record every assumption with its prior value, its new value, the evidence supporting the change and the effect on the indicated reserve in dollars: tail factors, loss development factors, expected loss ratios, trend and severity assumptions, and discount or claim closure rates where used.
Flag every assumption change above the materiality threshold for reserve committee approval and hold it until approved.
Save the model run in the reserving platform with a version number, the run date and the analyst id so the result can be reproduced exactly.
checklist.done: each segment has a documented method rationale, every assumption change is quantified in dollars, and material changes are held for committee approval.

checklist.step: Validate the reserving models independently
actions: Confirm every model in production is registered with a tier, an owner, a validation date and a validation expiry date.

Perform or refresh the validation covering conceptual soundness, data inputs, implementation testing against an independent recalculation, benchmarking against an alternative method, and back-testing prior estimates against actual emergence.

Record every validation finding with a severity and a remediation date and confirm no model with an open high-severity finding is used for the booked estimate without an approved compensating control.
Apply change control: any change to model code, parameters or the platform version requires testing, approval and a validation impact assessment before production use.
checklist.done: every production reserving model has a current validation with back-testing, findings tracked, and change control applied before any production change.

checklist.step: Run the reserve committee review each quarter
actions: Distribute the reserve pack at least 3 business days ahead: indicated ranges and selected point estimates by segment, movement from the prior quarter split between actual versus expected emergence and assumption change, and the actual-versus-expected analysis by accident period.
Present the large loss and catastrophe developments, the reinsurance recoverable impact, and any segment where actual emergence fell outside the expected corridor.

Have the committee - Chief Actuary, Controller, Chief Risk Officer, Chief Underwriting Officer and Chief Claims Officer - challenge each selection and record the challenge and the response in the minutes.
Minute the approved selected reserve by segment, every approved assumption change and any dissent, and issue the minutes within 5 business days.
checklist.done: each quarter has a distributed reserve pack, a minuted challenge, and an approved selected reserve by segment with assumption changes named.

checklist.step: Book the reserve and reconcile the actuarial estimate to the ledger
actions: Prepare the booking journal from the committee-approved selected reserve by segment and attach the minute reference as support.
Reconcile the booked gross and net reserve to the actuarial selection by segment and explain every difference, including any management margin, in a written memo.
Where the booked amount falls outside the actuarial indicated range, require written CFO approval and Audit Committee notification before the entry posts.
Have a preparer and an independent approver evidence the journal, and confirm the ledger balance ties to the reserve roll-forward used in the ASC 944 disclosure.
checklist.done: the booked reserve ties by segment to the committee-approved selection with differences explained, and any out-of-range booking has CFO approval.

checklist.step: Operate access and segregation controls over the reserving environment
actions: Restrict write access to the production reserving platform, the model library and the parameter files to named actuarial staff, and remove developer access from production.
Run a quarterly access certification over the reserving platform and the reserve data marts and require the Chief Actuary to certify every entitlement.
Confirm the person who runs the model cannot approve the selected reserve and that the booking journal preparer is not the actuary who set the assumptions.
Log every production model run with the user id, timestamp and version so a result can be attributed to a person and a version.
checklist.done: production reserving access is restricted and certified quarterly, run logs attribute every result, and preparation, approval and booking sit with different people.

checklist.step: Support the Statement of Actuarial Opinion and the actuarial report
actions: Perform the reserve adequacy analysis supporting the Statement of Actuarial Opinion and confirm the data tested reconciles to Schedule P of the annual statement.
File the opinion with the annual statement by 1 March and provide the supporting Actuarial Report to the board and the domiciliary commissioner by the state deadline, commonly 1 May.
Disclose in the opinion any risk of material adverse deviation with the materiality standard used and the basis for it.
Present the opinion and the reserve adequacy conclusion to the Audit Committee and record the presentation in the minutes.
checklist.done: the actuarial opinion is filed by 1 March reconciled to Schedule P, the actuarial report is delivered by the state deadline and both are presented to the Audit Committee.

checklist.step: Prove the reserve controls inside the SOX programme
actions: Confirm the RCM carries key controls for reserve data reconciliation, assumption approval, model validation, committee approval, booking review and the roll-forward disclosure, each mapped to the valuation and completeness assertions.
Record for each management review control the precision: the segment-level dollar threshold that triggers investigation, and evidence of an item actually investigated in the year.
Ensure the ITGC scope covers the reserving platform, the data marts feeding it and the interfaces from the claims and policy systems.
Schedule these controls for testing every quarter and treat any failure as presumptively at least a significant deficiency given the materiality of the reserve balance.
checklist.done: reserve key controls sit in the RCM with review precision and investigated examples, ITGC coverage of the reserving stack, and quarterly testing scheduled.

checklist.step: Draft the ASC 944 reserve disclosure from the tested numbers
actions: Build the liability for unpaid claims roll-forward showing beginning balance, incurred related to the current and prior years, paid related to the current and prior years, and the ending balance, gross and net of reinsurance.
Build the incurred and paid claims development tables by accident year with IBNR and claim frequency, and the reconciliation from the development tables to the balance sheet liability.
Explain material prior-year development by segment with the reasons, drawing the wording from the reserve committee minutes rather than writing it fresh.
Tie every figure in the disclosure to the reserving platform output and the general ledger in the tie-out binder.
checklist.done: the roll-forward, development tables and prior-year development explanation are drafted from committee minutes and tied to the platform and the ledger.

checklist.step: Report the reserve position and policy compliance to the board
actions: Present to the Audit Committee each quarter the reserve movement, the actual-versus-expected analysis, the assumption changes approved and the reserve range against the booked position.
Confirm explicitly whether the quarter's reserving work complied with the board-approved reserving policy and name any departure with its approval.
Present the model validation status, open high-severity findings and any model used with a compensating control.
Minute the committee's questions and directions and convert each into a tracked action with an owner and a date.
checklist.done: the committee receives a quarterly reserve and policy compliance report naming every policy departure and open model finding, with tracked actions minuted.

checklist.step: Confirm every in-scope policy was approved in the year
actions: Reconcile the policy register to the board and committee minutes and confirm each policy has an approval resolution dated within the last 12 months.
Confirm the approved version number in the resolution matches the version published in the policy library staff actually use.
List every policy approved with a materially amended text and confirm the redline and change summary were before the approving body.
Report any policy with no approval in the year, or a version mismatch between the resolution and the library, to the Nominating and Governance Committee.
checklist.done: every in-scope policy has a resolution dated within 12 months whose version number matches the published policy, with mismatches reported.

checklist.step: Archive the reserve and policy approval evidence
actions: File per quarter the data reconciliations, data quality report, assumption change memos, model validation reports, reserve committee pack and minutes, booking journal support and the reconciliation to the ledger.
File per year the approved policy versions, the board resolutions, the actuarial opinion and the actuarial report.
Apply permanent retention to board resolutions and approved policies and the 7-year SOX 802 label to the reserve workpapers.
Confirm the record is searchable by segment, valuation date, model version and policy version and give the external auditor and the state examiner read access on request.
checklist.done: reserve workpapers are archived under a 7-year label and policy resolutions permanently, searchable by segment, valuation date and model version.

testing.step: Build the population of reserve controls, segments and policies
actions: Export from AuditBoard every key control mapped to the loss reserve, policyholder liability and reinsurance recoverable accounts with owner, frequency and assertion.
Extract the full list of reserve segments with their booked balances at the valuation date and the list of models used for each.
Extract the policy register with each policy's last board approval date and version number.
Reconcile the segment balances to the general ledger reserve accounts and sign the population as complete with the extract date.
testing.done: reserve controls, segments, models and policies are extracted and the segment balances reconcile to the ledger, signed as complete.

testing.step: Reconcile the reserving data back to the claims and policy systems
actions: Independently extract paid losses, case reserves and claim counts by accident period from the claims platform using your own query and compare totals to the actuarial extract.
Compare earned premium by segment from the policy administration platform to the actuarial exposure base and to the ledger.
Trace 15 claims from the claims system into the triangle and 15 triangle cells back to claim records, testing both completeness and accuracy.
Record every difference above tolerance and confirm the reconciliation on file explains it rather than absorbing it into an adjustment.
testing.done: an independent claims and premium extract agrees to the actuarial data within tolerance with two-way tracing of 15 items each way documented.

testing.step: Draw a documented sample of assumptions, models and controls
actions: Take 100 percent of assumption changes above the materiality threshold, all long-tail segments, all models with an open validation finding and every quarter's reserve committee minutes.
Take 15 further reserve key controls by seeded random selection across the remaining population.
Add every segment with adverse prior-year development in the year and every segment booked outside the indicated range.
Record the seed, population sizes and selection date so the sample can be redrawn identically.
testing.done: a reproducible sample covers all material assumption changes, long-tail segments, flagged models, adverse-development segments and all committee minutes.

testing.step: Re-perform the assumption approval and quantification
actions: For each sampled assumption change open the memo and confirm it records the prior value, the new value, the supporting evidence and the dollar effect on the indicated reserve.
Re-run the model in the reserving platform with the prior assumption and confirm the stated dollar effect, recording your recomputed figure alongside management's.
Trace the change to the reserve committee minute that approved it and confirm the approval pre-dates the booking.
Treat any assumption changed without a memo, without a quantified effect, or approved after booking as an exception.
testing.done: each sampled assumption change has an independently recomputed dollar effect traced to a committee approval that pre-dates booking.

testing.step: Re-perform the model validation and version control tests
actions: Confirm every model used for the booked estimate is registered with a validation dated inside its validity period and an assigned tier.
Independently recalculate one segment's indicated reserve using an alternative method and compare it to the platform output, investigating any difference beyond the expected method spread.
Compare the model version recorded in the run log to the version in the validation report and to the version in the production library, and flag any mismatch.
Confirm no model with an open high-severity finding was used without an approved and tested compensating control.
testing.done: model registration, validation currency and version alignment are verified and one segment is independently recalculated by an alternative method.

testing.step: Test the reserve committee governance and challenge record
actions: Confirm each quarter's committee met with the quorum the terms of reference require and that the pack was distributed at least 3 business days ahead, taking the timestamps from the portal.

Read the minutes for evidence of substantive challenge - questions asked, alternatives considered, selections changed - and treat minutes recording only approval as insufficient evidence of a review control.
Confirm every segment selection and assumption change appears in the minutes with an approved figure rather than by reference to a pack.
Trace any dissent or unresolved question to its resolution in the following quarter.
testing.done: each quarterly meeting evidences quorum, timely distribution, substantive challenge and per-segment approved figures in the minutes.

testing.step: Recompute the booking, the roll-forward and the disclosure
actions: Agree the booked gross and net reserve by segment to the committee-approved selection and recompute the total difference, including any management margin, against the actuarial indicated range.
Where the booking sits outside the range, confirm the written CFO approval and the Audit Committee notification exist and pre-date the posting.
Recompute the ASC 944 roll-forward - beginning balance, current and prior year incurred, current and prior year paid, ending balance - from the ledger and agree it to the filed disclosure.
Recompute the incurred and paid development tables for two accident years and agree the reconciliation from the tables to the balance sheet liability.
testing.done: the booked reserve, out-of-range approvals, roll-forward and two accident years of development tables are independently recomputed and agreed to the filing.

testing.step: Test access, segregation and policy approval currency
actions: Pull the production reserving platform entitlement list and confirm no developer or non-actuarial user holds write access and that the quarterly certification was completed by the Chief Actuary.
Confirm the person who ran the model, the person who approved the selection and the person who prepared the booking journal are three different people for each sampled segment.
Reconcile the policy register to the board minutes and confirm every in-scope policy carries a resolution within 12 months with a matching version number.
Open the published policy in the staff library and confirm it is the version the resolution approved.
testing.done: production access is restricted and certified, three-way segregation holds per segment, and every policy has a current resolution matching the published version.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise an issue per exception naming the segment, control, model or policy, the dollar effect on the reserve where quantifiable, and whether the estimate itself is affected.
Assign a root cause (extract not reconciled, assumption changed outside governance, validation expired, minutes lack challenge evidence, segregation breach, policy approval lapsed) and a named owner.
Given the materiality of the reserve balance, classify any control failure as at least a significant deficiency unless a tested compensating control demonstrably reduces it, and record that analysis.
Set a remediation date that leaves at least two quarterly operating cycles before the year-end assertion and carry the item into the next quarter's test.
testing.done: each exception has a quantified reserve effect where possible, a root cause, an owner, a severity analysis and a remediation date leaving two operating cycles.

testing.step: Conclude, obtain independent sign-off and report
actions: Compute the exception rate over sampled controls, assumption changes and models and compare it to the zero-tolerance thresholds for unreconciled data, ungoverned assumption changes and expired model validations.

Write the conclusion - controls over reserve estimation are effective, effective with exceptions, or ineffective - citing the data reconciliation, assumption recomputation, model validation and booking workpapers.
Have a reviewer who set no sampled assumption, ran no sampled model and prepared no booking journal sign the workpaper with name and date.

Report the conclusion, any quantified reserve effect and any policy approval lapse to the Audit Committee and the Risk Committee before the year-end ICFR conclusion, and file the workpaper in the evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper states the exception rate, the conclusion and the committee reporting date, delivered before the year-end ICFR conclusion.
